name: DRIFT
author: hundekraft
description: DRIFT has no oscillator in the usual sense. A small neural net, trained on real instruments and classic synths, draws every waveform while you play, hundreds of times a second, right on the OP-1. The four encoders don't set a filter or an envelope. They move you through what the net learned, so one turn can bend a flute towards a bell, or land somewhere between a choir and a bass that nobody ever recorded.
